en:
Hey, Shuichi!
Let's have a proper battle today!

So how about we play a game called
the Burning Apology?
The Burning Apology!?

Yup! Beg me not to kill you, while
kneeling on a burning hot metal plate!

If you reeeeally wanna live,
then I know you can do it!

I can't do that, I would die!
And that doesn't sound like a "game"...
Huh. So you figured it out.
Of course I figured that out!
Then, how about the...Steel Beam Walk?
Steel Beam Walk?

You walk across on a thin steel beam and make
it to the end without falling! Then you win!
Ah...that sounds...alright.

By the way, the beam is placed between two
buildings. There's also electricity involved.

And of course, you plan on
crossing it as well?

Of course I'm gonna cross it!
I'm pretty confident when it comes to balancing!

But that's a lie!
So no! I won't go!

<CLT=cltMIND>He's putting a lot of effort into
messing with me...

Is there something else we can do?
I want a game of life-or-death.

Kokichi, these challenges... The idea is
that if I win, I don't die, correct?
Yuppers! And?

Then why are we *both*
risking our lives?

Who cares? We're gonna die anyway some day.
This just changes the timing a little.

I'm the supreme leader of evil!
I'm used to risking my life!

...But you don't do any
steel beam walking.

Ah-haha, of course!
What I said was a lie!
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm used to it at this point.

Soooo then, how about we just do a simple
game of rock-paper-scissors?

Rock-paper-scissors?
Isn't that all luck?

Nee-heehee... But that's why it's fun!
Shuichi, good luck on surviving!

O-kay! Here I goooooo!
Rock, paper, scissors!
We both put out the same thing.

I see. Again.
Ready? Rock, paper, scissors!
<CLT=cltMIND>...The same again?

Nee-heeheehee!
How long will you prolong your life, Shuichi?
Rock, paper, scissors!
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
Rock, paper, scissors!
The same again...
Ugh! I'm bored now!

This is the bajillionth time we tied!
Shuichi, please just finish it up!

There's not really...
anything I can do...

Fine, then we're done for today.
Congrats, Shuichi. You're still alive.
Oh yeah, by the way...

Did you know there's a way to throw the same
thing on purpose in rock-paper-scissors?
Huh?
Nee-heeheehee...

<CLT=cltMIND>Was that what Kokichi was doing
just now? So that he wouldn't win?
<CLT=cltMIND>But what would be the point of that?
You only have two events left...
I hate lies and jokes.

But I'm lying.
You just have good luck, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>We got the same thing a hundred times.
That's not just "luck"...

Maybe your detective's intuition is getting more
precise. Well, you are the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Still...the next time we meet will be your last.
Enjoy the little time you have left, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>I returned to my room,
mind and body exhausted...

<CLT=cltMIND>So, it will all be over after one more
event. Somehow, I doubt it...
